We take all disputes seriously and are investigating your claim. As per the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to verify the identity of the account holder and ensure that the debt is valid. We will conduct a thorough review of the account history and verify the information provided.

Regarding the account balance, the current amount due is $5,831.47. The original creditor for this account is Liberty Credit Corp. The charge-off date for this account was May 11, 2024, and the last payment date was October 3, 2025.

We will provide a validation of the account, including the account balance and any relevant account history, as required by the FDCPA. We will also investigate your claim that the account was filed incorrectly and may have been associated with an incorrect address.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe that the investigation does not resolve your concerns. If you wish to continue disputing the debt, please provide us with any additional information or documentation that you believe is relevant to the dispute.

Sincerely,

Redstone Collections Group
